name: test1
description: Test1 integration for looking up geolocation and network ownership details for an IP address via ipinfo.io

api_token.label: Access Token
api_token.help_text: Generate an access token from your ipinfo.io dashboard at https://ipinfo.io/account/token

lookup_ip.description: Returns geolocation and network ownership details for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, including city, region, country, coordinates, and the owning organisation or ASN. Omit the address to look up the caller's own IP.

ip_address.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up. Leave empty to look up the IP address of the caller.

ip.description: The IP address that was looked up

city.description: City the IP address is registered to

region.description: State or region the IP address is registered to

loc.description: Latitude and longitude as a comma-separated pair

org.description: Owning organisation, prefixed with its ASN
